title: Selfhood Before Heredity: Prebiotic Grounding of a Peptide Coacervate Organization, and Its Route to an Evolvable Quasi-Autogenic Organization
description: Reframes the origin-of-life needle-in-a-haystack problem as a percolation problem in peptide/protein configuration space, approached from a modern-protein side (GB1-derived interacting peptide systems) and a geochemical side (Deacon's autogenic principle, realized experimentally by Matsuo and Kurihara's proliferating peptide coacervate, and grounded in a physically realizable reaction-space path back to geochemical matter).
